summary: mStock drops the socket: the feed reconnects, sends LOGIN again and subscribes the instrument again, and packets on the new connection reach the client.

deviations.reason: mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369, quote_data.get('oi', 0) over the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out until a packet has carried one, and then sends the last OI the instrument's full packet carried on this connection (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs merges by presence), never a 0 it was not sent.
deviations.ref: decisions 2026-11-09: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out; web openalgo#2376
